title: Code Agent Output — Generated Test Artifacts
description: The only SUCCESS shape Code Agent produces, written to agent-output/CodeAgent-Output/<TICKET>.code.json. On invalid input, or when Code Agent's own attempted output fails Ajv validation, a DIFFERENT small ad hoc shape is used instead (pipeline/schemas/code-output-error.schema.json), written to a DIFFERENT file (<TICKET>.code.error.json) — never this schema with error fields bolted on, and never overwriting the last known-good success file. Every fileOperations[] entry's path/kind/mode must trace back to an entry in ticket.designFile's newArtifacts[] (checked by the validator, not this schema — the same way design-output completeness is checked in JS, not JSON Schema).

designFile.description: Path (relative to repo root) to the <TICKET>.design.json this output implements, e.g. agent-output/DesignAgent-Output/CAP-15.design.json. This is the ONLY input Code Agent reads for requirements/scope — the requirements baseline itself is never re-read.

runMode.description: generate: first full implementation of the design plan — every newArtifacts[] entry should get a fileOperations[] entry. rewrite: Test Agent sent structured failure feedback and ONLY the named failing artifacts were regenerated at per-file granularity — see the rewrite object below, required when this is "rewrite".

fileOperations.description: One entry per file Code Agent created or extended this run. In a rewrite run this is ONLY the regenerated files, never the whole suite. Every path here must resolve to an entry in the design plan's newArtifacts[] (never reuse[]-only) — Code Agent does not invent files beyond what the plan calls for.

path.description: Repo-relative path, e.g. pages/DashboardPage.ts. Must match a newArtifacts[].path in the design plan named in ticket.designFile.

mode.description: Copied verbatim from the matching newArtifacts[] entry in the design plan — Code Agent never re-derives create-vs-extend itself.

content.description: The FULL file content on disk after this operation (the whole file, not a diff) — the same bytes actually written via Write/Edit.

purpose.description: Optional — what this file operation accomplishes, usually a short restatement of the matching newArtifacts[] entry's purpose.

scenarioIds.description: Design scenario IDs this file operation supports. May be empty only for plan-wide infrastructure not tied to a single scenario (e.g. a shared fixtures/pages.ts wiring change touched by many scenarios at once).

compile.description: Result of running `tsc --noEmit` against the whole framework after generating/regenerating files. At most one self-correction retry is allowed (FR-059) — the counter resets on each new generation/rewrite cycle, including each rewrite round-trip.

attempts.description: The initial compile attempt, plus (only if it failed) exactly one self-correction retry. Never more than 2.

diagnostics.description: Parsed tsc diagnostics for this attempt. Empty array if exitCode is 0.

finalStatus.description: "fail" means tsc never passed after both attempts — the validator hard-fails this (AC #10), do not hand it to Test Agent even though the JSON itself is schema-valid.

passedOnAttempt.description: Which attempt's exitCode was 0. null if finalStatus is "fail" (still failing after the one retry).

designFile.description: Same value as ticket.designFile, repeated here for the renderer/validator's convenience.

newArtifactsFulfilled.description: Paths from ticket.designFile's newArtifacts[] that now have a corresponding fileOperations[] entry. In a generate run this should equal ALL of newArtifacts[].path; in a rewrite run it's only the regenerated subset.

scenariosCovered.description: Union of every fileOperations[].scenarioIds this run produced.

rewrite.description: Required to be a real object (not null) when runMode is "rewrite" — enforced by the validator, same reasoning as design-output's conditional performanceNote requirement, since a plain schema can't express "required only when a sibling field has a given value." Must be null when runMode is "generate".

roundTrip.description: Which of the 3 allowed Code<->Test round-trips this is.

budgetExceeded.description: True if, as far as Code Agent can tell, this round-trip pushed the cumulative wall-clock spend (across all round-trips for this ticket, including tsc self-correction retries) past the 18-minute cap. Code Agent reports what it can see about its own round-trip; summing elapsed time ACROSS separate invocations and deciding whether to allow a 4th round-trip is the orchestrator's responsibility, not tracked end-to-end by either agent alone.

triggeringFailures.description: Test Agent's structured failure feedback that triggered this rewrite, one entry per failing test.

regeneratedPaths.description: Should equal fileOperations[].path for this run exactly — a rewrite touches ONLY the failing artifacts (the .feature file, its .steps.ts, and any POM class it touches), never the whole suite.
